standalone.finding: inside the soil-water loop Irrigation(3) is called only under flDayStart when sw_multi_swap == 0; TimeControl(9) follows and may constrain the step to the irrigation event end
standalone.selection_meaning: scheduled trigger evaluation is a management opportunity attached to the standalone day-start orchestration, not a test on every soil-water solver interval

multiswap.finding: when sw_multi_swap == 1, Irrigation(4) is called at day start while Irrigation(3) is called at day end
multiswap.selection_meaning: legacy MultiSWAP separates scheduled selection from subsequent availability scaling; the kernel cannot infer this ordering from interval duration or midnight

active_event_reset.finding: TimeControl calls Irrigation(9) when the irrigation event end is reached; task 9 clears irrigevent, gird, qssdi, dt_irr_event and qssdisum

target_semantic_consequence.owner: management/runtime composition outside the kernel process equation
target_semantic_consequence.new_event_start_rule: a scheduled event may start only when selection_opportunity is true and all admitted outer management gates pass
target_semantic_consequence.continuation_rule: an already committed scheduled event continues independently of selection_opportunity until its stored event end
target_semantic_consequence.post_completion_rule: completion clears active scheduled state; no immediate retrigger is allowed unless a later request explicitly supplies a new selection_opportunity
target_semantic_consequence.fixed_event_precedence: a new scheduled event is forbidden when fixed_event_already_selected is true
target_semantic_consequence.generic_time_contract: selection cadence is management semantics; event continuation and split handling remain generic over [t0,t1]

architectural_effect.persistent_state_growth: only an explicit active-event origin discriminator is needed to share the existing compact irrigation continuation state safely between fixed and scheduled events
